peter2.2.p1.b1.text: Now there were also false prophets among the people, …

peter2.2.p1.b2.text: … just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them …

peter2.2.p1.b3.text: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. …

peter2.2.p2.b1.text: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;

peter2.2.p2.b2.text: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;

peter2.2.p2.b3.text: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;

peter2.2.p3.b1.text: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—

peter2.2.p3.b2.text: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials …

peter2.2.p4.b1.text: … They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.

peter2.2.p4.b2.text: … They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. … reveling in their deception as they feast with you.

peter2.2.p4.b3.text: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, …

peter2.2.p4.b4.text: … a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.

peter2.2.p5.b1.text: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. …

peter2.2.p5.b2.text: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.

peter2.2.p5.b3.text: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
